text: Transformer neural network architecture removes the scale constraint on training data but not the quality constraint, so data quality continues to be a major unsolved issue for large language models even where internet scale corpora are available.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
